text:
alex (PM): quick sync 3 long1term initiative: routing policy matrix + tenant isolation tiers for multiregion launches. need acceptance criteria before we brief execs.

maria (Arch): list hard constraints: data residency, p95 latency caps, crossregion failover time, and masking for noisy tenants.

sam (Eng-runtime): runtime impact: isolated slices -> pinned pools, affects batching and KV cache hit rate. cost estimate will be 2040% higher per qpu.

tyler (Sales): customers ask for "isolation" meaning both residency + performance isolation. can we gate via revenue or contract size?

nina (SRE): ops needs: eviction playbook, cutover runbook, surge tests. define SLO per tier or we lose oncalls.

john (Security): add: KMS boundaries, audit retention, and HSM for private installs. map those to tiers.

alex (PM): proposed tiers: Shared / SliceSegregation / Dedicated. each must have routing precedence, fallback, SLA band, and launch tests.

acceptance checklist (draft):
- tier definitions (oneliner)
- routing policy DSL + engine mapping
- SLA matrix (p95 latency, availability)
- residency & KMS mapping table
- launch tests: chaos cutover, tenant surge, billing reconciliation
- sales gating language (revenue + security signoff)

maria (Arch): i'll draft a policy-toengine mapping next week.

sam (Eng-runtime): i'll put up a DSL strawman by EOD tomorrow (affinity, maxBatch, kvTTL).

tyler (Sales): i'll draft gating copy for SOW. prefer automated billing flag for assignment.

nina (SRE): will sketch runbooks and failure modes. add autofallback to shared with degraded SLA for longtail mitigation.

john (Security): will deliver KMS/HSM checklist and timeline.

alex (PM): action: collect artifacts by Fri for leadership triage. react with :white_check_mark: when ack.

maria (Arch): ack :white_check_mark:

sam (Eng-runtime): ack :white_check_mark:

tyler (Sales): ack :white_check_mark:

alex (PM): keeping this thread canonical for the initiative. will upload the spec after collating.
